questions: What is the memory ownership model for qttune_mock_signal_set()? The removed code accessed set->defs[i] which could be problematic if the data has different lifetime requirements.
Why was the SignalBatchesAreCoalesced test removed? This test verified timing contracts for the batching behavior.
How should the LiveViewPage functionality be reimplemented now that SignalListModel is removed?
Is there a plan to add atomic tracking for queued frame backlog to prevent unbounded queue growth?
nits: The removed code had a hardcoded 8-byte buffer for qttune_decode_signal which would be incorrect for CAN-FD frames (64+ bytes).
Consider adding a comment explaining why m_currentFrameCount is accessed from the worker thread in the new code.
The forceFrameCountForTesting function was removed along with the test that verified boundary conditions - this reduces testability.
